assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has a diagnosis of atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10).
The patient has a diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9).
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was performed.
The service was denied under Reason Code CO-197.
The denial was due to missing prior authorization.
The clinical indication confirms the medical necessity of the procedure.
